observations: Three photos show a white console with a perforated right side and a black left side, with a white controller in front.
The console has a small 'X' logo on the bottom right corner and a small 'X' logo on the top left corner.
The controller has the standard Xbox layout: D-pad, two analog sticks, four colored buttons (Y, X, B, A), and the Xbox logo.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The controller shows minor scuffs and wear, especially on the grips and buttons.
No games, discs, or cables are visible in any photo.
The seller claims 'No games' and 'Working perfectly', 'No single fault'.

claims.evidence: No games, discs, or game cases are visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
No video or photo of the console powered on or in use. No proof of functionality is provided.
The console and controller appear intact, but internal faults (e.g., disc drive, power, connectivity) cannot be assessed remotely.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional (e.g., no power, no disc drive, no internet connectivity)
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, showing the Xbox dashboard, and playing a game or streaming content.

risks.risk: Controller may have internal faults (e.g., unresponsive buttons, analog sticks, or battery issues)
risks.proof: Video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game, showing all buttons and sticks responding.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the serial number and model label on the back or bottom of the console, and a video of the console booting up with the official Xbox logo.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the Xbox dashboard.
Video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.
Close-up photo of the serial number and model label on the console.
Photo of any included games, discs, or cables.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
